We'll have to merge manually then :/

> We can still merge here, why would it need to be manual @bobylito

Because I thought it was illegal :)

> I guess this is good, but it's hard to review 😄

TBH this is impossible to review completely. Everything was already reviewed. Just check that we are ok on script side of things. Thanks for the time :)

Possibly wrong place to report, but this broke the links on https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/examples/
https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/master/docs/examples/tourism
needs changing to https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/tree/master/docgen/src/examples/tourism etc
Congrats guys! Looking forward to using it 😃

@Mark-Howe I don't see any errors. The new website lives [on /v2](https://community.algolia.com/instantsearch.js/v2/) and we made the mistake to use the name of the former doc source folder for the new destination folder.

Let us know if you find any broken links :)
